product_one_liner.value: Aikido provides a developer-first security platform that helps software teams secure their code, cloud infrastructure and runtime without slowing development.

eng_blog.notes: Qualifying posts cover Opengrep's architecture and taint-analysis improvements, by OCaml engineer Dimitris Mostrous, and Altar's model development, coauthored by Machine Lead Engineer Selim Decamps.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes getting started, scanning capabilities, developer integrations and AutoFix.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Software Engineer (AI Pentest), with responsibilities building AI hacking agents; posting verified live on November 10, 2026.

model_provider.value: OpenAI; AWS Bedrock; Aikido Altar, developed starting from GLM-5.3.
model_provider.notes: OpenAI is listed for AI inference; AutoFix uses models hosted on AWS Bedrock; Altar powers on-premises Aikido Machine.

compliance_certs.notes: Specifically claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 compliance.

raised_18mo.notes: The $60 million Series B was announced January 14, 2026, within the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Account Executive Enterprise posting, verified live on November 10, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: Introduced Aikido Altar in September 2026, an open-weight AI model powering on-premises autonomous pentesting.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jeff Poczatek's profile lists his start as VP Sales Commercial US at Aikido in February 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The CRM Manager posting explicitly describes operating Aikido's own HubSpot instance.
